name: strikethroo-scope-watch
description: Warns when Claude edits a file outside the Output Artifacts of the one Strikethroo task in progress. It warns and never blocks. Reads .ai/strikethroo/ and never writes to it.

mode.title: Warning style
mode.description: "toast" shows a notification for a few seconds; "notice" adds a dim line to the transcript, which Claude doesn't read; "off" turns the mod off.
